We need to determine the crime(s) based on facts. The case: a man (纪某) used his wife's status to fraudulently obtain land compensation payments from village committee. He falsified that his wife was a contract teacher (but she was a formal teacher, not eligible). He submitted false documents, deceived officials, obtained 97,000 RMB. He later turned himself in, returned money.

This is fraud (诈骗) or maybe "非法获取公民个人信息"? No, it's fraud of compensation. Likely "诈骗" (fraud) or "骗取国家补偿款" maybe "诈骗罪" (fraud). Could also be "行贿"? No. "受贿"? No. "挪用公款"? No. "非法占有" but the specific crime is "诈骗" (fraud) or "骗取国家补偿款" which is a type of fraud. In Chinese criminal law, obtaining compensation by false means is "诈骗罪". So answer: [罪名]诈骗<eoa>.
